proposals.before: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer the young Meng east of Wu.”
proposals.after: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer Ah Meng of Wu.”
proposals.reason: 吳下阿蒙 is a nickname/allusive expression for Ah Meng of Wu. The current east of Wu is not in the source; young also obscures 阿蒙 as the name. Preserve the complete quotation.

proposals.before: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer the young Meng east of Wu.”
proposals.after: Chui said to him: “Your capacity and insight have advanced; you are no longer Ah Meng of Wu.”
proposals.reason: Correct the same geographical/name mistranslation in the paired literal field; 吳下 is Wu, not east of Wu, and 阿蒙 is Ah Meng.

proposals.before: Murong Chao, whom he had summoned from Chang'an, now arrived.
proposals.after: Murong Chao, his elder brother's son, whom he had summoned from Chang'an, now arrived.
proposals.reason: The source explicitly says 德...其兄子超: Chao is De’s elder brother’s son. Restore that omitted relationship and preserve his arrival after the earlier summons.

proposals.before: Earlier, De had welcomed his brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point he arrived.
proposals.after: Earlier, De had summoned his elder brother's son Chao from Chang'an; at this point he arrived.
proposals.reason: Restore the explicit elder-brother relationship in 兄子 and the earlier summons versus current arrival. Independently check 迎 in its full narrative context; no new date or identity is inferred.

proposals.before: Murong Chui, impressed, began debating statecraft and strategy with him, and Murong De’s advice was always blunt and to the point.
proposals.after: Murong De’s elder brother Murong Chui was greatly impressed and began debating statecraft and strategy with him, and Murong De’s advice was always blunt and to the point.
proposals.reason: 德兄垂 explicitly calls Chui De’s elder brother, as the literal field already says (De’s elder brother Chui). The idiomatic field drops this kinship. I also checked the elder-brother wording in s0272. 甚壯之 means he greatly admired him.

proposals.before: When Murong Chui defected to Fu Jian, Murong De lost his post as an accomplice.
proposals.after: When Murong Chui defected to Fu Jian, Murong De was implicated and dismissed from office.
proposals.reason: 坐免職 means De was dismissed because he was implicated in Chui’s flight (坐, liability by association). As an accomplice says he took part, which the source does not say. The literal (sat fault and was dismissed) is a calque without that claim, so I leave it.

proposals.before: He named Murong Chao crown prince and issued a broad amnesty.
proposals.after: He issued an edict naming Murong Chao crown prince, proclaimed a general amnesty within his realm, and raised by two degrees the rank of every son who was his father’s heir.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic field leaves out 子為父後者人爵二級, a concrete grant in the same edict that the literal field keeps. 下書 (issued an edict) and 境內 (within the realm) are also restored. No date or person is added.

proposals.before: When Chui fled to Fu Jian, De sat fault and was dismissed from office.
proposals.after: When Chui fled to Fu Jian, De was implicated and dismissed from office.
proposals.reason: The literal calque sat fault does not convey the legal implication expressed by 坐免職. Restore the proposition that De was implicated and dismissed, preserving Chui’s flight and naming no new event participant.

decisions.reason: I re-checked the earlier independent approval and it holds. 吳下 means in Wu, not east of Wu, and 阿蒙 is the familiar name Ah Meng, which 'young Meng' hides. Tongjian 66 confirms this is Lu Su's jibe at Lü Meng. 'Ah Meng of Wu' keeps the whole quotation and assigns no new identity or date in chapter 127.

The same correction applies to the paired literal field, which currently matches the idiomatic field word for word. 'Ah Meng of Wu' renders 吳下阿蒙 exactly. I re-checked the earlier approval: the before-text matches the current field and the proposal is unchanged.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 汝器識長進，非復吳下阿蒙也

decisions.reason: 其兄子超 makes Chao the son of De's elder brother, which the idiomatic field drops. The new text restores it and keeps 初 (the earlier summons) separate from 及是而至 (his arrival now). The father stays unnamed, and no date is added. I re-checked the earlier approval and the bindings match exactly.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 初，德迎其兄子超于長安，及是而至

decisions.reason: 兄 means elder brother, so 'brother's son' is too vague. 迎 here is De's earlier act of sending for Chao from Chang'an, which comes before 及是而至. 'Summoned' keeps those two stages apart, and nothing new is inferred. I re-checked the earlier approval and it holds.

德兄垂 calls Chui De's elder brother, as the literal field already says, and the current idiomatic text drops this. 甚壯之 means greatly impressed or admiring. Everything else is kept unchanged: 因共論軍國大謀 (debating statecraft and strategy together) and 言必切至 (his advice always blunt and to the point). Both men are named in the source, so nobody is identified or merged by inference.

In 坐免職, 坐 marks liability by association: De was dismissed because of Chui's flight. 'As an accomplice' claims he took part, which the source does not say. 'Was implicated and dismissed from office' is accurate, and Chui's defection to Fu Jian is kept unchanged.

The current text leaves out 下書 (issued an edict), 境內 (within his realm) and the grant 子為父後者人爵二級. The new text restores all three: a two-degree rise in rank for every son who was his father's heir, which matches the literal field. Chao's title as crown prince (皇太子) is kept, and no date or person is added.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 乃下書以超為皇太子，大赦境內，子為父後者人爵二級

decisions.reason: The calque 'sat fault' does not get across the legal sense of 坐 (being implicated). The new text says De was implicated and dismissed from office, keeps 'When Chui fled to Fu Jian' as it is, matches the approved idiomatic repair and names no new participant.

cautions: This is an editorial review of English wording only. It cannot approve any chronology, identity, the chapter or publication. The chronologyHold (needs-revision) is untouched.
